content.title: What to know about Paramount's hostile bid for Warner Bros. Discovery
content.summary: Warner Bros. Discovery's friendly agreement to sell itself to Netflix just got upended by a hostile actor -- Paramount, which made Warner shareholders a higher offer and touched off what is likely to be a lengthy fight in the latest episode of media industry consolidation.  The bid comes after Warner last week agreed to be bought by Netflix for $72 billion.  Netflix’s vast library includes “Stranger Things” and “Squid Game," while the much smaller Paramount owns its Hollywood studio and major TV networks like CBS and MTV.
